explain_task.question: In the revised model, explain why the objective drops from 1866.38 to 1811.00 by tracing the new QA-tier and craftsman split all the way from the business brief to the exact code variables and CSV fields. Your answer must name the revised decision variables `product_Y_QA`, `craft_reg`, and `craft_ot`, the constraint names `Product_Y_QA_Tier` and `Craftsman_Time_Balance`, and the exact CSV parameter names/values that implement the “up to 60 batches of Product Y” and “one-time 10 GBP QA burden” logic; then use the revised solver records to identify which constraints are binding, report their slack/dual values where available, and interpret the business meaning of those marginal values. Finally, compare the original and revised solutions and pinpoint the exact code additions/modifications that force `Y` down to 60 and `X` up to 18, quantifying how much of the 55.38 profit change comes from the QA fee versus the regular/overtime craftsman-cost split, and explain why you cannot linearly extrapolate the LP-relaxation shadow price on `Product_Y_QA_Tier` to predict the integer model’s profit if the threshold were increased above 60.
